data.name: Final Rites
data.detailed_description:
FINAL RITES PROTOCOL

CONFIDENTIAL REPORT, ARCHIVE COPY

OVERVIEW

After a series of unexplained incidents in a remote village in northern Spain, a group of exorcists was dispatched. No further communication was received.

Following the loss of contact, a secondary unit was authorized.

Designation: FINAL RITES.

This unit is not tasked with absolution.

Its purpose is containment.

THE SITUATION

What began as a localized religious disturbance has escalated into a spreading condition affecting the entire region.

The village appears intact, yet abandoned. Signs of daily life remain undisturbed, but no inhabitants are present.

Inside, reality itself shows signs of instability:

  • spaces that do not match their external structure

  • doors leading to unknown locations

  • environments that shift and disorient

THE THREAT

Entities encountered are not fully understood.

The dead do not remain at rest.
Termination does not guarantee neutralization.

Some entities resemble former inhabitants. Others do not correspond to any known form of life.

In multiple cases:

  • movement occurs without visible cause

  • figures appear where no one is present

  • reflections act independently

Destruction alone is insufficient.

Something remains.

BREACHES

Certain locations act as transition points between realities.

These are not conventional portals, but unstable openings where:

  • sound is distorted

  • light behaves irregularly

  • space itself becomes unreliable

Personnel have reported crossing into environments that do not exist within known geography.

Some have not returned.

FAILURE OF EXORCISM

Initial ritual procedures did not eliminate the presence.

They altered it.

What was once contained is now unbound.

The situation is no longer a haunting.

It is a spreading condition.

YOUR ROLE

You are part of the FINAL RITES unit.

A military esoteric squad deployed when exorcism fails.

Your mission is to:

  • investigate corrupted locations

  • engage hostile entities

  • perform sealing rituals

  • contain the spread

You will explore abandoned structures, forests, and underground sites while confronting the aftermath of failed rites.

Some threats can be destroyed.

Others must be bound.

DIRECTIVE

  • Do not rely on standard exorcism procedures

  • Destroy remains when possible

  • Apply sealing rites to stabilize affected areas

  • Do not assume cleared zones remain safe

Engagement alone is insufficient.

What is encountered must be contained.

FINAL NOTE

Recovered records from the first unit include the following:

“We thought it was inside the village.
It is not.
The village is inside it.”

END OF REPORT

data.short_description: After exorcists sent to a remote Spanish village go silent, the FINAL RITES unit is deployed. Investigate sites corrupted by failed rituals, explore hostile environments, fight the undead, and perform sacred rites to contain entities emerging from a breach beyond reality.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64bit required)
  • Processor: Intel corei5-8500 / AMD Ryzen 5 3500
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1660 6GB / Radeon RX 5500 XT 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Supports 1080p gameplay (using upscaling, native resolution of 640p)/30fps. Note: Frame rate may drop when the processing load is high. An SSD is required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64bit required)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060 Super 8GB / Radeon RX 6600 8GB
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Supports 1080p gameplay (using upscaling, native resolution of 720p)/60fps. Note: Frame rate may drop when the processing load is high. An SSD is required.

content_descriptors.notes: The game mainly features zombies and grotesque or horror-type enemies that the player must eliminate using firearms or other methods. When injured, enemies bleed.
